items.reviewBody: This is a great company. We had a roof replaced, and although we have had issues with continued leaks (it is a flat commercial roof with problems with drainage), he has remained true to his word, responsive and willing to fix what needed to get fixed. Stand up person.

This company has been extraordinary throughout this 2 month process of remodeling. Constructor has been here to check up on everyone almost every single day and the progress every that they have made has been incredible. We had a bunch of renovations done throughout the house. some of them included cabinets, paint, furniture, and flooring. Turn out was great.

This company is one of the most professional builders I could have found. They took care of every need & want I could have had. They were very attentive and always put their best foot forward when handling the customer. Thank you again for my beautiful home!
